content.short: Hummingbot is an open-source local library to create and execute automated trading strategies or bots.
content.description: Hummingbot is a trading strategy bot creation framework that supports both centralized and decentralized platforms. Professional market makers can assemble bots that implement proven templates, such as Avellaneda, to automate market-making strategies. Developers can build bots via BotCamp and run them on Miner to earn dividends. It supports a wide range of venues and enables flexible automation for professional traders. The project has grown to over 1 million downloads and reports an average 24-hour volume of around 100 million.
